; ==== DEMOGASX1701.SPF
;M01
R16=chk_pret

G01 G41 X58.155 Y99.488
G01 X57.991 Y99.39
G01 X57.849 Y99.262
G01 X57.734 Y99.11

G01 X57.6 Y98.755
G01 X57.586 Y98.565
G01 X57.608 Y98.375
G01 X57.666 Y98.193
G01 X57.757 Y98.026
G01 X57.879 Y97.879
PROFILE
G03 X57.402 Y98.5 I2.121 J2.121
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,57.402,98.5,57.879,97.879,0,0)
NEXT_L(130.,100.,1,2,3)
G01 G41 X125.539 Y98.805
G01 X124.895 Y98.538
G01 X124.343 Y98.114
G01 X123.919 Y97.562
G01 X123.653 Y96.919
G01 X123.562 Y96.229
G01 X123.653 Y95.539
G01 X123.919 Y94.895
G01 X124.343 Y94.343
PROFILE
G03 X123.072 Y96. I5.657 J5.657
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,123.072,96.,124.343,94.343,0,0)
NEXT_L(-5.,0.,1,2,3)
G01 G42 X0. Y0.
PROFILE
G01 X300. Y0.
CORNER
G01 X300. Y200.
CORNER
G01 X0. Y200.
CORNER
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,0.,200.,0.,0.,0,0)
ENDGEO
IF R16==1
	  STOPRE
	  R16=0
   GOTOB CICLA
ENDIF
ENDPART
RET
